claim: The merge-claims-guard CI check's blanket continue-on-error (parked in PT PR #354, .github/workflows/ci.yml) is a deliberately deferred fix, not a resolved one. CodeRabbit correctly flagged that it tolerates any failure of verify_merge_claims.py, not just the known 'its'/'the' stopword false-positive -- a genuine invocation error or a real merge-claim violation would also pass silently. Do not narrow this fix opportunistically mid-session; it is scheduled for the next migration/cleanup pass, not an ad-hoc detour.

decisions.notes: Explicit HITL scoping decision, 2026-08-16: user authorized the blanket park ('just disable it... park it as v2 fix') after the false-positive proved irreproducible locally against the exact CI checkout state (refs/pull/354/merge). CodeRabbit's follow-up finding (review 4945126748) about the fix's over-broad blast radius is valid and already known -- recording it here so a future session doesn't waste time rediscovering it, and doesn't 'fix' it without checking whether the migration pass has already landed a proper solution.
